fullPassage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes plain silliness. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with fundamental processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 views가 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 경관 — (B) 견해: 두 자리가 서로 뒤바뀌었어요.
❌ ② (A) 견해 — (B) 방문 횟수: (B)의 views는 '방문 횟수'가 아니라 눈에 보이는 '경관'이에요.
✅ ③ (A) 견해 — (B) 경관 ←정답: (A) accepted views of society는 사회의 '견해·의견'을 뜻하고, (B) views of the valley는 눈앞에 펼쳐진 '경관·전망'을 뜻해요. ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 종류 — (B) 경관: (A)의 views는 '종류'가 아니라 '견해'예요.
det.tip: accepted views = 견해 / views of the valley = 경관.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"something that you think is true although you have no proof"

det.analysis:
❌ ① evidence: '증거(evidence)'는 오히려 증명해 주는 것이라 정의와 반대예요.
❌ ② conclusion: '결론(conclusion)'은 근거를 따진 뒤 내리는 것이라 정의와 달라요.
❌ ③ principle: '원리(principle)'는 기본 규칙을 뜻해 정의와 맞지 않아요.
✅ ④ assumption ←정답: '증거가 없는데도 사실이라고 생각하는 것' = 가정(assumption)으로 정의와 정확히 일치해요. 본문 'beliefs or assumptions(믿음이나 가정)'의 그 단어예요. ←정답
det.tip: 증거 없이 사실이라 여기는 것 = assumption.

questions.passage: However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is __________ (devote) to understanding people: how and why we act as we do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
빈칸 앞에 'is'가 있고, 뒤에 전치사 'to'가 이어져요. 'be devoted to ~'는 '~에 전념하다, 헌신하다'라는 수동태 표현이에요.

동사 devote(바치다, 전념하다)를 과거분사 devoted로 바꿔 'is devoted to understanding people(사람을 이해하는 데 전념한다)'이 됩니다.

그래서 정답은 devoted예요. (be devoted to + 명사/동명사)

questions.passage: Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or __________ (assume).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
빈칸은 'generally held beliefs or ______' 자리예요. or 앞의 명사 beliefs(믿음, 복수)와 나란히 이어지므로 같은 명사 형태가 필요해요.

동사 assume(가정하다)을 명사 assumptions로 바꿔 'beliefs or assumptions(믿음이나 가정)'가 됩니다. 앞의 beliefs가 복수라 복수형으로 맞춰요.

그래서 정답은 assumptions예요. (assume → assumption → assumptions)
det.tip: or로 명사 beliefs(복수)와 나란한 자리 → 명사 복수 assumptions.

questions.passage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes plain silliness. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with __________ processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① fundamental ←정답: 심리학이 '______ 과정과 원리', 즉 문화·사회적 다양성을 '만들어 내는' 원리를 다룬다는 흐름이에요. 그런 원리는 '근본적인(fundamental)' 것이에요. ←정답
❌ ② modern: '현대의(modern)'는 마지막 문장에 나오지만 이 자리의 과정·원리를 꾸미기엔 어색해요.
❌ ③ shared: '공유되는(shared)'은 뒷부분의 원리를 설명하는 말이라 이 자리엔 맞지 않아요.
❌ ④ different: '다른(different)'은 심리학과 통념을 대비할 때 쓴 말이라 여기선 어색해요.

questions.passage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes plain silliness. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and __________, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with fundamental processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① evidence: '증거(evidence)'는 심리학자들이 오히려 '찾는' 것이라 의존하지 않는 대상과 반대예요.
✅ ② hearsay ←정답: 심리학자들은 '의견과 ______, 혹은 사회의 통념에 의존하지 않는다'는 흐름이에요. 의견과 나란히 놓이는 것은 근거 없는 '소문(hearsay)'이에요. ←정답
❌ ③ research: '연구(research)'는 근거 있는 활동이라 의존하지 않을 대상이 아니에요.
❌ ④ proof: '증명(proof)'도 증거처럼 심리학이 추구하는 것이에요.
det.tip: 의견과 나란히 의존하지 않는 것 → 소문(hearsay).
